verdict.rationale: GitLab's technology-partners directory lists a Zulip integration that sends notifications about GitLab projects to chat, plus a Slack integration for interacting with GitLab from a Slack workspace. Both are thin directory blurbs, not first-party integration docs. Missing for 10: documented Slack/Discord/Microsoft Teams notification integrations, configurable repository and merge request event selection, first-party setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
